verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a manually invoked CLI review (`/review`-style) against uncommitted changes, a commit, or a base branch, run before a pull request is opened. That is a one-off local action, not an automatic review triggered on every pull request. Starting Codex cloud tasks from GitHub pull requests and calling `codex exec` from CI are adjacent features and developer building blocks, not a documented automatic PR-review capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
